description: This Java source file defines the main class ECUExec for the RomRaider project, responsible for initializing and launching the ECU editor interface, handling system properties, and managing application startup routines.

classes.name: ECUExec
classes.description: Main class for launching the RomRaider ECU editor application, handling startup routines, logging, and user interface initialization.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that initializes logging, system properties, look and feel, and opens the ECU editor.

methods.name: showAlreadyRunningMessage
methods.description: Displays a message indicating the application is already running.

methods.name: containsLoggerArg
methods.description: Checks if command-line arguments include logger flags.

methods.name: openRom
methods.description: Asynchronously opens a ROM image in the ECU editor.

methods.name: openEditor
methods.description: Initializes and opens the ECU editor UI, optionally opening a specified ROM.
